title: ShredBench: Evaluating the Semantic Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Document Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2604.23813v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) tasks, but their capabilities are mainly evaluated on pristine, well-structured document images. We consider content restoration from shredded fragments, a challenging VRDU setting that requires integrating visual pattern recognition with semantic reasoning under significant content discontinuities. To facilitate systematic evaluation of complex VRDU tasks, we introduce ShredBench, a benchmark supported by an automated generation pipeline that renders fragmented documents directly from Markdown. The proposed pipeline ensures evaluation validity by allowing the flexible integration of latest or unseen textual sources to prevent training data contamination. translated_title: ShredBench：评估多模态大语言模型在文档重建中的语义推理能力
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉富文本文档理解（VRDU）任务中取得了显著的性能，但其能力主要是在原始完整、结构良好的文档图像上进行评估的。我们考虑从碎片中恢复内容这一具有挑战性的VRDU场景，该场景要求在内容严重不连续的情况下，将视觉模式识别与语义推理相结合。为了促进对复杂VRDU任务的系统性评估，我们提出了ShredBench，这是一个由自动化生成流程支持的基准，该流程可直接从Markdown渲染生成碎片化文档。所提出的流程通过允许灵活集成最新或未见过的文本源来防止训练数据污染，从而确保评估的有效性。ShredBench评估四种场景（英文、中文、代码、表格）以及三种碎片粒度（8、12、16片）。
tldr: ShredBench是一个由自动化流程直接从Markdown生成碎片化文档的新基准，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型在碎片文档重建任务中结合视觉识别与语义推理的能力，并可通过引入新文本源防止训练数据污染。
en_tdlr: ShredBench is a new benchmark featuring an automated pipeline that renders fragmented documents directly from Markdown, enabling systematic evaluation of multimodal LLMs' ability to integrate visual recognition with semantic reasoning in reconstructing shredded documents, while preventing training data contamination through flexible integration of new text sources.
